briefdescription.para: NLG-01: Exactly kMaxConcurrentConnections admissions succeed; the next one returns CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (bounded ceiling).

detaileddescription.para: Uses a small limit (8) to keep the test fast while verifying the invariant.

briefdescription.para: NLG-02: CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED is not connection-closing for the rejected new connection — it was never admitted.

detaileddescription.para: Validates: kMaxConcurrentConnections contract constant is sane.

briefdescription.para: NLG-03: After startDrain(), new messages get SERVER_DRAINING; the connection is still alive (not connection-closing for that code).
NLG-04: CLOSED state is terminal — all sends return TRANSPORT_CLOSED; TRANSPORT_CLOSED is connection-closing.
NLG-05: kConnectionIdleTimeout is positive and finite — the contract constant must be sensible.
NLG-06: A connection that has been idle beyond the threshold transitions to DRAINING (model: the timeout manager drains it).
NLG-07: BACKPRESSURE_EXCEEDED at full queue is transient (retryable); after drain the connection resumes normal admission — no permanent stall.
NLG-08: Under rapid bursts of over-limit accept attempts the counter stays exactly at limit — no under-count (memory safety) or over-count (state corruption) occurs.
NQP-01: QUIC connection migration under 1%-simulated packet-loss is modelled as FALLBACK_ACTIVE — NOT connection-closing (migration ongoing).
NQP-01b: When fallback is triggered (migration active), TRANSPORT_FALLBACK_ACTIVE is NOT connection-closing.
NQP-02: kTransportFallbackDelay is a positive duration bounded below the auth handshake timeout — the fallback window is a real, sane interval.

detaileddescription.para: Note: kTransportFallbackDelay governs when a transport path is considered failed and a fallback path is activated. It is intentionally larger than a 0-RTT window (QUIC 0-RTT resumption completes at the TLS layer before fallback detection even triggers). This test validates the constant's structural invariants, not the 0-RTT handshake duration itself.

briefdescription.para: NQP-03: QUIC normal-path connect returns OK — no throughput regression to error codes under normal operation.
NQP-04: QUIC auth/session guard is identical to TCP path — same contract constants apply.
NQP-05: QUIC with invalid TLS state → TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed); connection-closing.
NQP-06: kTransportFallbackDelay is positive and bounded — contract constant sanity gate.
Phase 4 — Connection Lifecycle Guardrails + QUIC Production Readiness focused tests (NLG-01..NLG-08, NQP-01..NQP-06).

detaileddescription.para: Covers two Q4 2026 and Q3 2026 open items from src/network/ROADMAP.md:

(a) § Planned Features — Harden connection lifecycle guardrails (limits, backpressure, timeout interplay) under peak load. (b) § Distributed Maturity Phase 3 Track 2 — HTTP/3 QUIC production enablement: connection migration, 0-RTT resumption, throughput parity.
All tests are deterministic and self-contained — no live sockets or real network I/O.

sect2.title: Test Cases
sect2.para: NLG-01 kMaxConcurrentConnections admissions succeed; admission N+1 returns CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (bounded). NLG-02 CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED is not connection-closing for the rejected new connection — it was never admitted.

NLG-03 DRAINING state rejects new messages with SERVER_DRAINING; in-flight messages submitted before drain start are represented as already-accepted (no retroactive rejection). NLG-04 CLOSED state rejects all messages with TRANSPORT_CLOSED; closed is terminal — no recovery.

NLG-05 kConnectionIdleTimeout constant is positive and bounded (sanity). NLG-06 Connection in SERVING state with no activity is marked for termination after idle threshold; model produces SERVER_DRAINING.
NLG-07 BACKPRESSURE_EXCEEDED at full queue is transient — connection stays open; queue depth does not stall permanently after drain.

para.heading: NLG-08 — Peak-Load Admission Control Without State Corruption

sect2.para: NLG-08 Rapid sequential CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED rejections leave the connection count exactly at kMaxConcurrentConnections (no under-count or over-count).

NQP-01 QUIC FALLBACK_ACTIVE during 1%-simulated packet-loss is NOT connection-closing (connection migration is in progress). NQP-02 0-RTT handshake mock: modelled timing fits within ≤ 50 ms gate. NQP-03 QUIC throughput-parity invariant: QUIC_OK path is OK (no regression to TRANSPORT_WRITE_ERROR under normal load). NQP-04 QUIC auth/session guard runs identical to TCP path. NQP-05 QUIC with invalid TLS state → TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed). NQP-06 kTransportFallbackDelay is positive and bounded (contract sanity).
